product: Higher limits and BROWSE support for Unity Catalog secrets
tagline: A schema can now hold up to 1,000 Unity Catalog secrets, and a metastore up to 10,000, up from 100 and 1,000.
what_it_does: A schema can now hold up to 1,000 Unity Catalog secrets, and a metastore up to 10,000, up from 100 and 1,000. The limits apply to Databricks managed secrets and secrets backed by AWS Secrets Manager. BROWSE on a catalog now applies to Unity Catalog secrets, so users can discover secrets and their metadata without being able to read the values or reference the secrets in code.
why_it_matters: This page describes how to create, read, govern, and manage secrets in Unity Catalog.
